title: Klippo Prebuilt Complete Prompt Catalog
source: Pre-rendered complete prompts from current subcategory variations and existing eight presets.

presets.cinematic: Realistic cinematic commercial, controlled soft light, natural shadows, one smooth motivated camera move.
presets.minimal: Clean studio, balanced soft light, negative space, restrained product-focused movement.
presets.lifestyle: Believable everyday setting, natural light, realistic product interaction.
presets.dynamic: Strong opening, energetic controlled pacing, one clear action, clean cuts.
presets.luxury: Premium lighting, refined contrast, controlled highlights, elegant framing.
presets.flatlay: Tasteful overhead or angled flat lay, deliberate spacing, soft shadows.
presets.creative_reveal: Reveal through framing, focus, light or camera movement; never transform the product.
presets.white_doodle: Thin white 2D doodles trace only visible product contours/details; never obscure the item or add captions.

prompt_variants.10:
VIDEO PROMPT — 10s | 9:16
PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Preserve the supplied garment's visible shape, colour, print, labels and construction; invent no features or claims.
STYLE: Realistic cinematic commercial with soft directional light, natural shadows and one smooth, purposeful camera move.
MODEL: No human or animal model; show the garment alone.
SCENE: Use a tasteful, simple fashion setting and keep the garment clearly readable.
ACTION: 0–2s Open with a clear full view of the garment and its overall silhouette. 2–7s Let the fabric sway gently once, then settle naturally; preserve the garment's exact cut and fit. 7–10s Finish with a sharp, stable full-product view.
CAMERA & LIGHTING: Use smooth, controlled movement and realistic fabric texture. Keep the colour, exposure and garment details consistent; do not reveal unseen sides.
AUDIO: Add restrained background music and keep it below any selected voice. Use SFX only for visible actions; no unrequested dialogue.
Keep the product realistic and consistent. No morphing, duplicate garments, invented accessories, captions, watermarks or added logos.

MODEL: A human model may wear or present the garment naturally; keep its cut, fit, print and colour unchanged.

AUDIO: Add restrained background music and keep it below any selected voice. Use SFX only for visible actions; no unrequested dialogue.
Keep the product realistic and consistent. No morphing, duplicate garments, invented accessories, captions, watermarks or added logos.
